name: ESP32-S3 + C6 on cable
label: ESP32-S3 with 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM (e.g. ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8, or a WROOM-1U-N16R8 for an external antenna) plus an ESP32-C6 as the 802.15.4 radio on UART (a C6 with a 0.96" screen as the radio shows the AP's status)
antenna: on the module or external (u.FL), per module; the C6 radio has its own
